HOW TO PLAY

Master the bouncing light orb

👆

Tap to Boost

Single tap anywhere on the canvas to propel your glowing orb in that direction.

📡

Echo Sonar

Walls are invisible in darkness! Impacts & double-taps emit sonar waves revealing nearby geometry.

⚠️

Avoid Red Hazards

Static, moving, and pulsing spikes reset your level instantly on contact.

🌀

Reach Exit Portal

Bounce through the invisible maze and enter the glowing emerald/gold portal to win.
